question: On 28 September 2026 the Budget Committee deliberated on buildings policy. The committee discussed, among other subjects, the extension of leases on the HELIOS and BECH buildings in Luxembourg. 1.
What is the general market rate for rent for comparable office blocks in Luxembourg as a whole, and in the district where the HELIOS and BECH buildings are located?
How much rent is actually paid for the HELIOS and BECH buildings?
Who owns these two buildings?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (27.11.2026) The price per m² for all areas in the HELIOS (ex-Drosbach (DRB)) building is EUR 35/m² per month, while it is EUR 41/m² per month on average for the Cloche d’Or district, according to the report by the property consultancy firm Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated (JLL) on the real estate market for office space in Luxembourg in the first quarter of 2026.

The price per m² for all areas in the Joseph Bech (BECH) building is EUR 35.50/m² per month, while it is EUR 43/m² per month on average for the Kirchberg district, according to the report by the property consultancy firm JLL on the real estate market for office space in Luxembourg in the first quarter of 2026. The total annual rental expenditure for the HELIOS (ex-DRB) building is EUR 10 059 000.

The total annual rental expenditure for the BECH building is EUR 17 800 000. The HELIOS (ex-DRB) building is owned by the company KOWAC S.à r.l., a limited liability company incorporated under Luxembourg law. The BECH building is owned by the company Joseph Bech Building Kirchberg S.N.C., a collective partnership (société en nom collectif) registered under Luxembourg law.
